hypotheses.adaptation: Round2 tau=1s improved fault RMSE 4.19% without gate violations. Final two faster settings 0.5s and 0.25s; no noise change, no further adaptation sweep below 0.25s.

acceptance: At least 2% clean group-macro RMSE gain OR 5% fault-event group-macro RMSE gain. Neither aggregate may regress >1%. No bag/receiver clean RMSE regression >max(0.01m/s,10%). No coverage/sample count loss, false-stop increase, schedule changes, or causal violations. ROS CI required.
data_policy: Existing validation is reused for selection; not independent test evidence. No final-test payload access or fitting on GNSS. All candidates and rejections retained.
